noticias.titular: Claude’s projects go from folder to conversation that splits the work into threads
noticias.entradilla: In September Anthropic announced a redesign of Claude’s projects, in beta and for Claude Code: users describe what they need and Claude divides it into tasks that run in the cloud.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: on the left, a conversation called “Coordinator” splits the work into three threads, each with its own branch, inside a box labelled “In the cloud”; the threads return their results to a shared “Memory”. Labels: Coordinator, In the cloud, Threads, Memory.

noticias.titular: Gemini Notebook now has an official API, though limited and in preview
noticias.entradilla: It lets other programs create notebooks and add sources to them, but only with personal accounts. An unofficial code library does more, although it may stop working without warning.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram of two paths to the same notebook: the upper one, labelled “Official API”, passes through a padlock and carries the label “Personal only”; the lower one, labelled “Unofficial”, is a dashed red line with the label “May break”. On the right, the notebook, labelled “Notebook”.

noticias.titular: Stanford gathers 52 causal studies on AI in schools and sees uneven results
noticias.entradilla: The November review goes from 20 to 52 studies and concludes that AI looks more promising for understanding new material than for producing assignments, but no use improves learning consistently.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a person uses an assistant, from which two paths lead: one towards “Understand” and another, in red, towards “Do the task”, and at the end a balance. Labels: Assistant, Understand, Do the task, Uneven.

noticias.titular: Gemini Notebook turns a notebook’s sources into an interactive website
noticias.entradilla: All it takes is typing “make me a site” in the notebook’s chat. Members of the groups have already tried it, and one has uploaded the result to Moodle.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram from left to right: three documents labelled “Sources” go into a notebook with a chat bubble labelled “make me a site”; out of it comes a web page with a panel and lines of text, labelled “Website”, which is downloaded as a “.html” file and uploaded to “Moodle”.

noticias.titular: Wharton releases Primer, an open system that turns a conversation into a simulation
noticias.entradilla: Wharton Generative AI Labs offers an open-source prototype in which a team of agents interviews the teacher and builds a simulation for students. Its authors warn that it has not been evaluated in classrooms.
noticias.imagen_alt: A diagram in two boxes: on the left, a teacher labelled “Teacher” hands over their conversation and receives a document with an approval mark, labelled “Design”; on the right, a student, labelled “Student”, talks to a character, labelled “Character”; below, a red arrow labelled “Report” returns from the simulation to the teacher.

noticias.titular: EduGems becomes EduPrompts because Google is replacing Gems with Skills
noticias.entradilla: The site with 174 prompts for schools changes its name and address. The prompts can still be copied into any other AI tool.
noticias.imagen_alt: At the top, a box labelled “EduGems” points to another labelled “EduPrompts”; below, a box “Gems” leads with a red arrow to another labelled “Skills”, and on the right a copy icon labelled “Copy”.

noticias.titular: Anthropic proposes organising AI agents' memory into four layers with a periodic review
noticias.entradilla: An Anthropic research text describes how to give an agent memory between sessions, and a teacher in the group has adapted their own system to that idea and explains it in an article with instructions.
noticias.imagen_alt: Four stacked layers, from top to bottom labelled “Profile”, “Notes”, “Wiki” and “Conversations”, and a curved blue arrow rising from the conversations to the profile, next to a moon labelled “Night review”.

noticias.titular: Gemini lets users export their interactive apps to a Google Sites site with one click
noticias.entradilla: Google has made it possible to publish an interactive app created in the Gemini app as a Google Sites site. The group discussed how useful it really is for teachers.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram: a speech bubble labelled “Gemini” leads, via an arrow labelled “One click”, to a web page with a padlock labelled “Private draft”; a second dashed arrow, crossed out in red, points to a dashed box labelled “Existing site”.

noticias.titular: Eductia offers a paid AI tool for preparing teaching materials in Catalonia
noticias.entradilla: The service generates learning situations, activities and assessment instruments aligned with Catalan regulations, and raises the question of what it offers over a general-purpose AI.
noticias.imagen_alt: Diagram in three layers: at the top, “Teacher”, a person in front of a web window; in the middle, “Eductia”, the service's own layer with documents and chained steps; at the bottom, two model providers, “OpenAI” and “Anthropic”, connected by a dashed line ending in a red question mark, “Country?”, over the country where the data is processed.
